originality.rationale: The newly established sharp leading coefficient for the optimal n-summand amplification function was compared with general quasi-Orlicz normability and upper-estimate criteria, logarithmic sequence-space geometry, and direct searches for equivalent finite-sum estimates. The 2019 normability theorem and 2025 r-convexification theorem do not yield this quantitative fixed-gauge coefficient, and the recent Orlicz/Lorentz-Zygmund paper describes Banach-space thresholds.
